advice_items.quote: Number one would definitely be volume negates luck... if everyone's making 100 calls, make 200.
advice_items.summary_en: Outwork your peers with massive outreach volume so skill and consistency beat luck.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用超大工作量抵消运气成分

advice_items.quote: Make sure you're taking care of your health, you're getting sleep... I don't focus in on the result, I focus in on the action.
advice_items.summary_en: Maintain peak sales performance by prioritizing health, sleep, and daily execution over outcomes.
advice_items.summary_zh: 注重健康睡眠并聚焦每日行动

advice_items.quote: Number two is listen more, talk less... practice active listening, really understanding what people's needs are.
advice_items.summary_en: Practice active listening to uncover a prospect's true needs and deliver a brief, tailored pitch.
advice_items.summary_zh: 多倾听少推销，精准把握需求

advice_items.quote: When I first started entrepreneurship I tried to become a millionaire in 90 days... if you want a safe bet on becoming a millionaire, think in 10 years.
advice_items.summary_en: Bet on yourself with a 10-year time horizon rather than chasing unrealistic 90-day riches.
advice_items.summary_zh: 戒除暴富幻想，坚持十年长期主义

advice_items.quote: Think what skill sets do I need to acquire... Go learn sales, stack a few hundred thousand, then start buying the next skill sets.
advice_items.summary_en: Identify core skills needed for your dream business, master sales to build capital, and reinvest in new skills.
advice_items.summary_zh: 先学销售攒本金，再持续购入新技能

advice_items.quote: I'm not your friend, but at the same time I care about you enough to challenge you... be the understanding expert.
advice_items.summary_en: Position yourself as an understanding expert who challenges prospects' limiting beliefs instead of being overly agreeable.
advice_items.summary_zh: 以专家身份挑战客户认知而非迎合

advice_items.quote: There's nothing guaranteed... would you rather be put on a salary or would you rather go out and get paid based on your performance?
advice_items.summary_en: Reject the false security of a fixed salary and embrace performance-based commission to build entrepreneurial discipline.
advice_items.summary_zh: 克服对纯佣金制恐惧，凭业绩拿回报

advice_items.quote: Don't pitch until you know you can close. Once you pitch and you know you can close, actually ask for it. I've had people tell me no five, 10 times in a row.
advice_items.summary_en: Relentlessly ask for the deal after qualifying and keep solving objections even through repeated rejections.
advice_items.summary_zh: 不惧连环拒绝，果断并反复要求成交

advice_items.quote: Follow up with the clients that are in the program and ask them if they have any referrals... nurture the relationship in the right way.
advice_items.summary_en: Nurture relationships with existing clients and consistently follow up to generate referral deals.
advice_items.summary_zh: 深耕现有客户关系，持续跟进裂变转介绍

advice_items.quote: If you're feeling stress, just do more things... watch more game tape, listen to more sales calls, do whatever you can to take action.
advice_items.summary_en: Overcome beginner stress and boredom by taking immediate action—reviewing call recordings and putting in reps.
advice_items.summary_zh: 用高密度行动与复盘消除新手期焦虑

advice_items.canonical_tag: OTHER:Ask Hard Questions & Have Tough Conversations
advice_items.quote: Closers ask hard questions... the more hard conversations you have, the more successful you are.
advice_items.summary_en: Ask uncomfortable questions about finances and consequences of inaction to properly qualify and help prospects.
advice_items.summary_zh: 敢于提出尖锐问题，多进行艰难对话

guests.first_money_or_break: 高中时期起便尝试汽车美容、代发货和房地产等副业但均未做大，做房产时甚至每月亏损三四千美元；19岁从大学辍学且背负逾1万美元债务后，经Alex Hormozi指导进入Gym Launch做销售，靠每天打200至400通电话（远超他人100通）在两三周内追平老手，最终实现年入超25万美元。
guests.role_or_title: Sales Closer at Gym Launch (Alex Hormozi)
guests.zero_start_advice: 用10年而非90天的长期视角押注自己，先聚焦掌握销售等高变现能力并攒下几十万美元本金，再购入下一阶段的技能；起步阶段用超大工作量（海量拨号、复盘录音）和专注日常行动来克服焦虑与不确定性。
